title: RTPS: Move standard PIDs from RTI-specific handler to v2 parameter sequence
description:
PID_DATA_TAGS (0x1003), PID_TYPE_CONSISTENCY (0x0074), PID_DOMAIN_ID
(0x000f), and PID_DOMAIN_TAG (0x4014) are defined in the OMG RTPS,
XTypes, and DDS Security specifications but were only reachable for
RTI vendors. Move them to dissect_parameter_sequence_v2 so all vendors
are handled.

PID_RTI_DOMAIN_ID (0x800f) remains in the RTI handler with its
inline QoS / PID_RELATED_ORIGINAL_WRITER_INFO_LEGACY handling.

Also fix typo: ei_rtps_pid_type_csonsistency_invalid_size.

AI-Assisted: yes (Copilot)
